title: Disney laser-plasma electronic fireworks
summary: Eric Hazeline tells of Disney laser-plasma electronic fireworks, about his Disney Imagineering years at Walt Disney Imagineering, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote:
Well, when I was at Disney, we were
developing electronic fireworks. And the
way we did it is we had a Q switch
neodyenium yag laser that we focused to
a spot in the atmosphere and we put so
much energy there that we ionized the
air and created ball lightning.

plain: Eric Haseltine, a former National Security Agency official who earlier worked at Walt Disney Imagineering, the company's design and technology arm, told the podcast host Jesse Michels that Disney was developing electronic fireworks. He says they focused a powerful laser on a spot in the air and put so much energy there that the air became electrically charged and glowed like ball lightning, a rare glowing ball sometimes seen in storms. It suggests how some glowing lights in the sky could be made by people.
